fact: The ARCOP pilot completion report states APPEL, launched officially on 14 October 2025, has phase 1 deployed (tender publication, e-submission, e-opening), phase 2 (evaluation and award) being integrated and phase 3 (audit, contract execution) prepared; 57 contracting authorities enrolled, 400 suppliers registered, 15 electronic procedures launched of which 9 opened.
title: Rapport d'achèvement de la phase pilote de la plateforme APPEL (Achats Publics en Procédures Électroniques)
